what:
## speed-sol2-small: a logged database locks on every salsa event, also outside `Db::log` (base-db db.rs, the event hook in `Db::with`)

- Where: `crates/base-db/src/db.rs` `Db::with`: the callback does `log.lock()` for every event whenever the database has a log (`Db::logged`, `Db::for_tests`), and pushes only while `Db::log` runs.
- Why: the firewall harness and every fixture test pay an uncontended lock (~20 ns) per validated or executed memo outside the logged closures too, about the cost of the validation itself (~35 ns); the firewall bench's absolute times are about twice a build's (docs/v2/plan/lanes/firewall/speed-of-light.md).
- Change: `EventLog` gains `active: AtomicBool`; `Db::log` sets it (release) before running `f` and clears it after; the hook reads it (relaxed) and returns before the lock when it is false. Same events kept: the lock is still taken while `log` runs.
- Test: the existing `Db::log` tests (events in order) unchanged; one more that an event outside `log` is not kept.

history.note: applied: crates/base-db/src/db.rs EventLog is a struct { active: AtomicBool, events: Mutex<..> }; Db::log/log_mut go through EventLog::record, which sets active (release) around f; the hook loads it (relaxed) before the lock. Test an_event_outside_log_is_not_kept in db/tests.rs
